title: Chosen compactification and compact-support image
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ admit a chosen compactification

$$
X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y,
\qquad f=pj,
$$

with $j$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $p$ proper. For this datum set

$$
Rf_!^{(j,p)}E:=Rp_*j_!E.
$$

For proper $f$, its identity compactification is $(j,p)=(1_X,f)$.

proof.text: Present the open immersion j as the object ProEt.mk j. Use the arbitrary-coefficient open localization equivalence q of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-comparison] to identify the actual inverse-image module functor followed by q.functor with slice restriction.

Slice restriction is additive sectionwise, so it preserves zero morphisms. Apply [new-localized-restriction-extension-exists] to obtain its left adjoint L preserving finite limits. Compose the adjunction with q.toAdjunction and transport its right side along the open-localization comparison to get q.functor followed by L left adjoint to actual module inverse image.

For the prescribed ring isomorphism c, the scalar-restriction functor is an equivalence e. The scalar-extension adjunction proved in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] identifies tensor extension with e.inverse by uniqueness of left adjoints. Reverse that equivalence adjunction and compose with the previous adjunction. The resulting e.functor followed by q.functor followed by L is left adjoint to the specified proEtaleRingModulePullback and preserves finite limits, because equivalences and L do. This proves proEtaleOpenRestriction_isRightAdjoint.

Compare this exact left adjoint with the already specified proEtaleRingOpenExtension using Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq and transport finite-limit preservation across that natural isomorphism. Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive supplies additivity from that of pullback; leftAdjoint_preservesColimits supplies finite-colimit preservation. The existing exact termwise derived functor and its proper-direct-image composite are unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Lemmas lemma-extension-by-zero (03DI) and lemma-extension-by-zero-exact (03DJ), transported using the existing pro-etale open localization comparison; categorical adjunction composition and uniqueness glue written by R3.

lean.statement:
def proEtaleRingCompactSupportImage {Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (d : Compactification f) [QuasiCompact d.i]
    (RY : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (RZ : Sheaf (ProEt.topology d.Z) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (RX : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (cp : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage d.g CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RY ≅ RZ)
    (cj : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage d.i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RZ ≅ RX) :
    DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X RX) ⥤ DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Y RY)
lean.note: The recorded etale fixed-coefficient functor cannot express arbitrary sheaves of commutative pro-etale rings. Reuse the reviewed Q09 representing left adjoint to actual open restriction, exact termwise derived extension, and its Rp_* composite. Its adjoint universal property determines the extension up to the unique compatible isomorphism.
